$description: Reusable production component architecture derived from the approved static design system.

components.name: SiteHeader
components.responsibility: Three-zone nav (logo left, links centered, CTA right), page-aware theming, scroll-compact state, route indicator
components.accessibility: landmark nav, current-page aria-current, skip link target

components.name: DesktopNavigation
components.responsibility: Centered link row + animated active-route indicator
components.accessibility: keyboard tab order matches visual order

components.name: MobileNavigation
components.responsibility: Full-screen menu panel for small viewports
components.accessibility: focus trap while open, Escape closes, focus returns to trigger on close

components.name: BrandMark
components.responsibility: Renders the canonical X geometry with a page-specific material/filter
components.routesUsing: all (header, footer, transition overlay, hero compositions)
components.accessibility: aria-hidden if purely decorative, labeled when it is the sole logo link
components.componentType: server (static SVG) with client wrapper for animated instances

components.name: PageTransitionProvider
components.responsibility: Root-level controller owning the persistent transition mark and overlay across route changes
components.accessibility: must not trap focus, must not block screen reader announcement of new route title

components.name: TransitionOverlay
components.responsibility: Visual overlay + BrandMark rendered by PageTransitionProvider
variants: per-destination signature, see axieonex-motion.json route-transition matrix
components.accessibility: aria-hidden true, decorative only

components.name: Footer
components.responsibility: Shared footer: brand, nav groups, legal links, contact email, copyright
components.accessibility: landmark contentinfo, link text descriptive

components.name: Button
components.responsibility: Primary/secondary/ghost button with consistent focus and press feedback
components.accessibility: native button/anchor semantics, visible focus ring
components.componentType: client only for magnetic variant, otherwise server

components.name: FormField (Input/Select/Textarea)
components.responsibility: Labeled form control with validation state
components.accessibility: label association, aria-invalid, aria-describedby for error text, never color-only

components.name: BookingWizard
components.responsibility: Multi-step qualification and scheduling flow shell
components.accessibility: step heading receives focus on change, progress announced, back/next reachable by keyboard

components.name: SlotSelector
components.responsibility: Date/time slot picker with timezone display
components.accessibility: each slot is a real button with accessible name including date and time
components.componentType: client, availability data from mocked source now / calendar API in production

components.name: HeroSignalReveal
components.responsibility: Homepage full-viewport hero composition (fragments -> mark -> caption)
components.accessibility: headline and CTA never depend on animation completing

components.name: EngineDiagram
components.responsibility: Three-stage scroll-driven revenue-engine visualization
components.accessibility: stage copy always present in DOM (not purely canvas-drawn), IntersectionObserver only swaps visual emphasis

components.name: FAQ
components.responsibility: Accessible disclosure list
components.accessibility: native details/summary

components.name: ServiceDetailTemplate
components.responsibility: Shared layout for all 7 service pages: problem, AI/human/client split, process, deliverables, related services, CTA
variants: 7 slugs, differentiated by service data + ServiceHeroVisual
components.accessibility: consistent heading hierarchy across all 7 pages

components.name: ServiceHeroVisual
components.responsibility: Per-service SVG motion (radar, calendar, rings, envelope, network, waveform, blueprint)
components.accessibility: aria-hidden, decorative

components.name: ArticleTemplate
components.responsibility: Editorial reading layout: category, title, reading progress, body, related articles
motionDependencies: none beyond reading-progress bar width binding
components.accessibility: single h1, sequential subheadings, skip-to-content

components.name: LegalPageLayout
components.responsibility: Shared layout for Privacy, Cookies, Terms: sticky TOC on desktop, single column on mobile, legal-review notice banner
components.accessibility: anchor scroll-margin-top under fixed nav, heading hierarchy

components.name: CookiePreferencesManager
components.responsibility: Consent category toggles with accept-all/reject-optional/save actions
components.accessibility: screen-reader confirmation live region after save, strictly-necessary switch always disabled+checked
components.componentType: client, persistence must move from localStorage to a real CMP in production

components.name: NotFoundSignal
components.responsibility: 404 hero: failed-signal visual resolving into recovery links
components.accessibility: recovery links available immediately, not gated by animation
components.componentType: client for the animated mark, server for the recovery links

components.name: AccessibilityUtilities
components.responsibility: Skip link, visually-hidden text helper, focus-trap hook, reduced-motion hook
components.accessibility: is the accessibility layer itself
